review_scope: Independent read-only review of retained original-EXE evidence; no invocation, runtime read, build, or source changes.

static_semantics.frame_handling: Advances FFrame cursor at [RDX+0x24]; the preamble separately checks frame data byte 0x41 and may call a helper using [RDX+0x1c]. This is frame parsing, not an access to receiver offset 0x28.
static_semantics.receiver_access: Reads pointer at [receiver+0x20]. If null, output is zero.
static_semantics.state_node_access: If receiver+0x20 is non-null, reads a pointer at [that_pointer+0x44]. If null, output is zero.
static_semantics.name_selection: For a non-null state node, if DWORD [node+0x38] == 0xffffffff, constructs fallback FName from the NUL-terminated UTF-16 string <uninitialized>; otherwise reads the QWORD at [node+0x48]. The resulting QWORD is written through output storage.
static_semantics.offset_distinction: The receiver field offset is +0x20, not +0x28. The subsequent +0x44/+0x38/+0x48 offsets are relative to the state-node pointer, not the receiver.
